correctness.rationale: For every integer m>=3 the parity normal form is proved directly: all even integers at least 2m are products; below T=3r+2m the only odd products are 3(r+2j) for 0<=j<ceil(m/3), while all odd integers at least T equal the smallest odd product plus a permitted even summand. This covers all finite additive sums and proves equality of the described semigroup, not merely generator inclusion. Even indecomposables lie exactly in [2m,4m); odd indecomposables are precisely the odd normal-form points below T. Counting even and odd gaps proves the genus and Frobenius number, with the m modulo 3 endpoint distinction. The pseudo-Frobenius proof checks every minimal generator and excludes smaller odd gaps by two adjacent even generators; the exceptional gap u-2 appears exactly when m mod 3 is 1. Standalone verify.py independently computes additive closure and all invariants for every m from 2 to 160 inclusive, returning VERIFY_OK. Computation is finite corroboration, while the symbolic proof establishes the unbounded quantifier.

value.rationale: Ideal multiplication of numerical semigroups is motivated by arXiv:2607.10778. The mixed product of O_2 with arbitrary maximal-embedding-dimension ordinary O_m is an intrinsic infinite one-parameter family with no arbitrary slicing. An exact membership normal form supplies its full gap set, minimal generators, Frobenius number, genus, pseudo-Frobenius numbers, and type uniformly, exposing parity and congruence phenomena and offering concrete input for further arithmetic of ideals. The classification is not a routine renaming of a geometric progression: for m>=3 the generator set consists of two arithmetic blocks. No assertion about broader products or asymptotic series is needed.
